purpose: Questions that a Bible keyword matched but that a human reviewer read and ruled are not about the Bible. Applied by tools/extract_trivia.py. Only the three general-knowledge trivia sources are filtered; the Bible-specific sources are taken whole.
method: Every strong-tier match was screened for non-biblical context and every medium- and weak-tier match was read in full. Broad false-positive families (Abraham Lincoln, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Scientology, the modern state of Israel, Catholic devotion to later saints, post-biblical Jewish practice) are handled by the veto rules in extract_trivia.py instead, so this file holds only the individual stragglers.
